Subject: Next steps & demo availability — Orbit Health

Hi Amit / Lena —

Thanks again for the call today — great discussion and really appreciate the clarity on the use case (clinical notes summarization + internal search for care teams). Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock in a technical deep dive/demo: 

Recap:
- Goal: Reduce time-to-insight for clinicians by surfacing summarized consult notes and embedding-based search across EHR text.
- Constraints: PHI stays in customer environment; must support SSO (SAML) and meet SOC 2 evidence requests.
- Success metric: 20% reduction in average time-to-find for relevant notes within the pilot cohort.

Proposed next steps (please pick options that work for your team):
1) 60-minute technical deep dive + sandbox walkthrough (we’ll bring a solutions engineer and platform engineer).
2) Prep items for security/procurement: SOC2 snapshot, data flow diagram, and a short mutual action plan (I’ve attached the SOC2 FAQ and a MAP draft).

Demo windows (all times PDT / convert as needed):
- Option A: Tue 17 Jun, 09:00–10:00 PT (12:00–13:00 ET)
- Option B: Wed 18 Jun, 14:00–15:00 PT (17:00–18:00 ET)

Can you confirm which option works, and please share the primary security contact (+ procurement contact or group email) so we can include them on the prep notes? If SSO is required for the demo environment, let us know the IdP metadata contact as well.

Looping Ben on cadence and logistics. I’ll block the two windows tentatively on our side and remove ones you don’t pick.

Thanks,

—Marissa Cole
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0147

- mutual-action-plan-draft.docx (stub)

Really helpful recap, thanks. Both windows look reasonable; leaning toward Option A (Tue 17 Jun 09:00 PT) because it gives our engineering and product teams time to prepare.

- Security (primary): Lena Ortiz — lena.ortiz@orbithealth.com (she’s on this thread)

Thanks Amit — locking Tue 17 Jun 09:00 PT for the deep dive (I’ll send calendar invite shortly).

Hannah / Rishi — I’m looping you both to help with the security and procurement prep for Orbit Health. Short ask below so we can keep the pre-demo work low-friction: 

For Security (Hannah):
- Can provide a brief 15–20 minute pre-demo sync or answer questions asynchronously.
- Primary items Orbit typically asks for: SOC 2 snapshot, data flow diagram, retention & deletion policy, and encryption-at-rest/key management notes. I attached a SOC2 FAQ.

For Procurement (Rishi):
- Orbit’s procurement team will want a mutual action plan and a sense of commercial terms and an initial SOW. I attached a MAP draft; we can refine once Orbit signals the pilot size.

Orbit team — please feel free to share any additional gating requirements (e.g., a security questionnaire). If it helps, Hannah can join the first 10–15 minutes of the demo for a quick live Q&A.

Next steps I’ll take:
- Send calendar invite for Tue 17 Jun 09:00–10:00 PT (tentative now).
- Share the two attachments to the procurement inbox and the security inbox.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to it.
